chunks: Mansur ibn Hazim narrated from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
"My father عليه السلام fell ill on the Day of al-Adha, so he prayed two rak'ahs in his house, then offered the sacrifice."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام do on Eid al-Adha when he was ill?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the father of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام was ill on the Day of Eid al-Adha and therefore performed two rak'ahs in his home before carrying out the sacrifice. It indicates a practical precedent concerning Eid prayer and sacrifice when illness affects public participation.
